describes: This pack's lamp kinds, referenced by a lamp's kind (its record, or lights.json until lamps are records). Colour from the lamp's spectrum as CIE xy; output in lumens (watts by efficacy) through the luminaire, with the share sent upward; a 3 x 3 rendition matrix (row-major, on linear Rec.709) for how the kind drains colour, identity for a full spectrum; warm-up in seconds from strike to full. The glass's luminance is what the eye sees of the lamp itself. Range is where the drawn light stops (a cost bound, not physics).
